message: 大いなる目標

name: Paqy
message: 「What's wrong, Synn-sama?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing. I sense something... This way!」

name: Kal Kan
message: 「Meow.」

name: Synn
message: 「A Demon in a place like this?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Halt, I say!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Insolent monster! Prepare to be slain--」

name: Kal Kan
message: 「Meow!」

name: Shio
message: 「Uwaaaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Watch out!」

name: Shio
message: 「L-Synn-dono...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't do it, Shio-chan. That one isn't like the Demons we usually fight... Its strength is on a whole other level.」

name: Shio
message: 「However, if we leave things as they are, the monster will escape--」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan!! You're hurt!」

name: Shio
message: 「T-Tis nothing more than a scratch... ngh!」

name: Kal Kan
message: 「Meow!」

name: Synn
message: 「We're falling back for now!」
I scooped up the crouching Shio-chan with ease.

name: Paqy
message: 「Time to skedaddle!」

name: Synn
message: 「We should be safe now that we've come this far.」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-You carried me so effortlessly...」

name: Shio
message: 「P-Please put me down! Please put me down!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, whoa! Don't thrash around, don't thrash around!」

name: Shio
message: 「Haa... Y-You really did something completely unnecessary.」

name: Shio
message: 「An injury of this degree merely put me at a slight disadvantage. Had we continued as we were...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Quit acting tough already. Can you even run on a leg like that? You wouldn't even be able to dodge a Demon's attack.」

name: Synn
message: 「First things first, I have to treat your wounds.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold out your leg.」
Fair, healthy-looking legs.
Her thighs and calves have just the right amount of flesh, and her ankles are tightly toned.
They must be well-trained. A quintessential athletic girl... though she does tend to be a bit too reckless.
Even though she's constantly doing things that leave her covered in fresh scrapes, those legs truly felt unmistakably feminine.
The red, swollen spots stand out starkly against the fairness of her skin.
Scrapes and bruises, huh... First, let's disinfect them.

name: Synn
message: 「This is gonna sting a little.」

name: Shio
message: 「Eeeh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Something like this is no big deal, right?」

name: Shio
message: 「I-If it stings... please spare me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hey!」
As she said that, she tried to pull away, and I instinctively grabbed her leg.

name: Shio
message: 「Hyaaaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry!」
Her leg was so soft it felt like my fingers might sink right in.

name: Shio
message: 「Tch... uuh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. I'll try to make it hurt as little as possible.」
Unable to even walk properly, she finally gives in.
Looking away from the injury, Shio-chan stretches out her leg.
Ah... her skirt must have flipped up earlier, leaving the gap between her thighs wide open...
Her white underwear is...

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono...?」
No, no, pull yourself together!

name: Synn
message: 「O-Okay, here I go...?」
I spray antiseptic onto the wound.

name: Shio
message: 「Ngh... kuu... uun...」
Shio-chan writhes at the sensation.

name: Synn
message: 「It's gonna sting a little, so bear with it, okay?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ah... ngh... nngh, uuh... tsuu... kuun!」
To finish up, I apply an adhesive bandage and a compress to the injured area.

name: Shio
message: 「Haa... haa... Is it... over?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That should do it. Don't push yourself too hard, okay?」

name: Shio
message: 「However, at this rate, Re-Crea will...」
Shio-chan speaks in a weak, frail voice.

name: Shio
message: 「I... have fought and worked alongside everyone in the Student Council up until now.」

name: Synn
message: 「We've even fought Demons together, right?」

name: Shio
message: 「Yet when it came down to it, what was I... nothing more than a complete good-for-nothing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not true at all! You've been a huge help!」

name: Shio
message: 「And yet, on my own... look at the sorry state I'm in.」

name: Shio
message: 「While everyone else has been steadily growing stronger, I... I...」

name: Shio
message: 「At a time of grave crisis for the world, I cannot even repel a single monster...」

name: Shio
message: 「At this rate, I will only drag everyone down when it matters most... I... I...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio-chan...」

name: Shio
message: 「Guh! I am not crying. This is merely the sweat of bitter frustration...」
Shio-chan wipes her eyes with her sleeve.

name: Synn
message: 「Even I can't stand up to Demons without this Rosary, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「No! I can tell. Both Jiiya-dono and Synn-dono--I sense an extraordinary aura from you both, unlike that of ordinary humans.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So she says.」

name: Shio
message: 「However, asking Jiiya-dono is like pushing against a curtain... He refuses to impart any teachings upon me...」

name: Shio
message: 「Even as I stack training upon training, the fiends grow stronger with each passing day, only widening the gap between us...」

name: Shio
message: 「At this rate... At this rate...!」
Shio-chan, who always acted so cheerful and fierce. Was she really worrying this much behind our backs?

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know if I can take Riesling-san's place, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's okay with you, could you let me tag along with your training, Shio-chan? I'll help out!」

name: Shio
message: 「I-Is that true!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Synn-sama. Quit saying irresponsible stuff. There's no way an ordinary human can go toe-to-toe with a Demon.」

name: Synn
message: 「You never know until you try, right? Besides, Shio-chan can fight even as an ordinary human.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's always supporting us, so if I can support her in return...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. Since you're a Great Sage, don't you know some good method?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well... if you draw the Demon's attention, Synn-sama, it's not impossible to take it down.」

name: Shio
message: 「Is that the truth!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Though, well, be prepared for it to take a pretty long time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, if it's possible, let's give it our best!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, it'd be an easy win if you just fought normally... What a pain. Still, I don't hate that kind of head-on mindset.」

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono... Paqy-dono...」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall master the art of slaying fiends no matter what it takes! And then, I will splendidly strike down our foes!」
